metaDescription: Order custom polyester cables & cords for your brand. Durable, tangle-free lanyards and keychains. Get a quote at Perfect Imprints today.
introHtml: Polyester cables and cords offer a durable, soft-touch alternative to nylon or rubber. They resist fraying and hold vibrant printed logos well, making them ideal for custom lanyards, badge holders, or keychains that see daily use. For trade shows or employee IDs, polyester provides a comfortable feel against the skin while maintaining strength. Choose polyester for a professional look that lasts through repeated wear.
heroAltText: Custom polyester cables and cords with printed logos, used for lanyards and keychains
